messages.content: 在一場撲克遊戲中，確定贏家是誰，約翰手中有8♥、10♥、J♥、Q♥、K♥，邁克手中有9♠、J♠、10♠、Q♠、K♠。

function.name: card_games_poker_determine_winner
function.description: Determines the winner in a game of Poker based on the cards in each players' hands. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

hand1.description: The list of cards (as strings) in first player's hand. E.g ['10♠', 'J♠']

hand2.description: The list of cards (as strings) in second player's hand. E.g ['9♥', '10♥']

message.content:
在這兩手牌中，兩位玩家都拿到了「順子同花」(straight‑flush)。  
- 約翰的牌序為 8♥‑10♥‑J♥‑Q♥‑K♥，最高牌是 K♥。  
- 邁克的牌序為 9♠‑10♠‑J♠‑Q♠‑K♠，最高牌同樣是 K♠。

順子同花的大小由最高牌決定；若最高牌相同，則比較次高牌，以此類推。  
邁克的順子同花從 9 開始，而約翰的從 8 開始，因為 9 > 8，邁克的順子同花更高。

**勝者：邁克**。
message.reasoning:
We need to determine winner. John has 8♥,10♥,J♥,Q♥,K♥. That's a straight flush? Actually 8-10-J-Q-K of hearts: that's a straight flush (8-10-J-Q-K). Mike has 9♠,J♠,10♠,Q♠,K♠. That's also a straight flush? Let's check: 9-10-J-Q-K of spades: that's also a straight flush. Which is higher? In poker, straight flush ranking: highest card matters. John's highest card is K of hearts. Mike's highest card is K of spades. They tie on highest card. Next compare next highest: J vs J, Q vs Q, 10 vs 10, 9 vs 8? Wait John's 8-10-J-Q-K; Mike's 9-10-J-Q-K. So Mike has 9 as the lowest card, John's lowest is 8. So Mike's straight flush is higher because the sequence is 9-10-J-Q-K vs 8-10-J-Q-K. Actually 9-10-J-Q-K is a higher straight flush than 8-10-J-Q-K. So Mike wins.

Thus answer: Mike wins.
